turns.text: Dana: We need to settle storage for the hosted MVP. Postgres or SQLite?
Postgres takes concurrent writes from all five friends at once. SQLite is a single writer, so their writes would queue behind each other. I would pick Postgres.
Dana: Agreed, we'll go with Postgres for the hosted MVP.

captures.title: Use Postgres for the hosted MVP
captures.rationale: Five friends write at once and SQLite is a single writer, so their writes would queue behind each other.
